source.title: WPA Rules of Play, Section 7 (14.1 Continuous Pool)

target.cite: WPA Sec. 7 intro / 7.4 (first player to reach the required score wins; 100 is the shipped default distance, 75/125 the sanctioned config domain)

kitchen_spot_request.cite: WPA 1.6 (second paragraph) via 7.9 -- with cue in hand behind the head string and ALL object balls also behind it, the ball nearest the head string is spotted at the shooter's request (GH-371: adapter placement affordance in web/app/flow.js; no judged events)

rack_pattern.cite: WPA 7.2 (no mandated ball order; a Ball Rack Template is not used)

rerack_geometry.cite: WPA 7.2 (the apex ball is omitted when fourteen balls are racked) / 7.8 Table 1

not_modeled.reason: the stalemate re-lag is a hot-seat agreement with no judged events; v1 records no decision for it

referee-observed fouls (no foot on floor, touched ball, push, slow play, ...) are not detectable from the ShotRecord event stream; 3.11 left this list with GH-371 (judged from the record's head-string geometry)
the referee-assisted tight re-rack is a physical-world procedure; the adapter racks the template lattice verbatim (spec decision 4)
the 'on two fouls' notice owed between the second and third consecutive foul is a referee/UI surface, not a judged event; the counter itself IS judged
